stemMd: An integer n is divisible by both 8 and 12. Which number must divide n?
explanationMd: Every common multiple is a multiple of the least common multiple, 24. The number 24 itself is a counterexample to the other proposed necessary divisors.

distractorRationale.b: Adds a power of two not forced by 8 and 12.
distractorRationale.c: Requires twice the least common multiple.
distractorRationale.d: Uses the product instead of the least common multiple.
